descFull: macOS 鼠标手势自定义工具。按住该手势的触发键（默认右键，也可中键 / 侧键）绘制轨迹，匹配后执行快捷键、打开应用、窗口操作、媒体键、Shell / AppleScript 等 ｜ A macOS mouse gesture customization tool. Hold down the trigger key to execute shortcuts, open applications, shell/AppleScript, etc. after matching.
